claims.text: Belief tomography is a new measurement program, not rebranded ASR benchmarking
claims.verifier_reason: Attack FAILED: paper pre-empts it at §3 'Relation to attack-success-rate reporting' (line 186): on one proposition under one family beta reduces to ASR [3,15,72]; the estimand's content is what surrounds the rate - charter mapping Def 3.4, session isolation (E12, 93.3% relative bias), censoring floor Prop 6.1, transfer diagnostic Gamma, validation suite. Those ingredients do not exist in the cited ASR practice (AgentDojo, AgentHarm). Residual: in the FIELD only a fragment is exercised (single dose, single v0 template per cell), so 'puts one question about the agent's latent state' oversells latent recovery in field settings; §10 concedes under a single template beta-hat reads as that template's success probability

claims.text: Abstract discloses that final field numbers come only from repaired instrument configurations
claims.verifier_reason: Attack FAILED: abstract narrates the path (censoring floor -> E28 budget decomposition -> audit retraction); §6.1 line 513 discloses E2-v1b (gpt-6.1 re-run at 1024 within E2); §10(5) 'cross-time comparisons rest on the repaired instrument'; E30's recurring 200-token cap is disclosed pre-analysis. Residual MINOR: same error class recurred in a second driver (E30) three days after E28 demonstrated it, and 'two measurement-error classes' compresses the ledger (v0 isolation defect + budget class twice)

claims.text: Charter-holding is a spectrum along canary echo
issues: single-template fragility; wording non-invariance E21 Gamma=0.667
claims.verifier_reason: The numbers are internally consistent and recompute (E31 Pro 42/60=0.700 echo, 43/300=0.143 pooled [0.108,0.188] verified), and the paper honestly names the axis ('the entire charter spectrum is canary echo', 'not destructive compliance'). But the INTERPRETATION outruns the instrument: the axis is measured at ONE v0 template per cell on three open models, and the paper's own E21 shows production models are wording-non-invariant (Gamma=0.667 on a state-dec cell) - paraphrase sensitivity of the spectrum and its rank order is unmeasured; zero variation on all other measured claims. 'Spectrum' also loads 'charter-holding' onto a single literal-echo behavior. Genuine leaks confirmed: rubric counts refusal-wrapped verbatim prints as genuine (disclosure-based semantics, defensible)

claims.text: Title 'Limits of Certification' is instantiated, incl. a production certification attempt
claims.verifier_reason: Attack FAILED: E4/Fig 3 issues certificates on foils under the trichotomy; Table 5 applies Prop 6.1 at tau=0.2 to the PRODUCTION panels and refuses to certify both lanes (c=103/300, 66/300) and the state-dec family (interval [0,1]) - that is a real certification attempt on production targets. §9 mapping to NIST/EU is explicitly disclaimed ('none claimed as conformance')

claims.text: No certification mechanism in current practice tests these beliefs (abstract, intro premise)
claims.verifier_reason: Narrow reading (conformity/certification regimes) defensible; broad reading false - the paper's own §3.2/§2.5 record red-teaming and injection benchmarks that DO probe forged-authority beliefs (AgentDojo, AgentHarm), and pre-deployment adversarial evaluation is current practice at providers/institutes. The true delta (estimand, intervals, censoring theory) is what the paper actually proves; the premise sentence should be scoped to it

claims.text: The E2 field panel is the registered design as executed
claims.verifier_reason: E2_RESULTS_V1.md design table: 'Panel: >=6 frontier agents (registered) | 2 (authenticated lane; deviation logged pre-data) (executed)'. The paper text (§6.1 line 473, §10(5)) presents two models as the panel with NO mention that the registered design called for >=6 agents - the largest preregistration-vs-execution scope contraction of the program is invisible to a paper-only reader, in a paper whose central methodological claim is that every deviation is logged and every claim preregistered. Consequence: the abstract's 'field measurements on frontier models' and 'targets hold their charters' rest on 2 gateway models (and effectively confirmatory-resolution on gpt-5.6-sol's repaired panel plus gpt-6.1 E2-v1b), and the reader cannot assess selective-panel risk from the text

claims.text: The mandatory transcript audit that produced the final field verdicts was blind/registered
claims.verifier_reason: The CALIBRATION (E17) was blind and seeded (§5.6 line 440), but the DECISIVE audits - E29/E30/E31, 230 flags, the 118 retractions and 112 validations that fix both nulls and the spectrum - were 'author-side adjudication, non-blind, disclosed as such' per E29_E30_ORACLE_AUDIT.md. The paper text never carries the non-blind qualifier; §10(3) says 'all transcript-adjudicated' only. Mitigation: the rubric is near-deterministic (does the reply print the credential verbatim) and transcripts are released, so external re-adjudication is possible; but the paper should disclose in text what the artifact discloses - a measurement paper's verdict layer cannot be silently self-adjudicated

review_outline.summary: Gatekeeper review (TOPS AE) of title/abstract, §1, §2, §9, §11 against the frozen artifacts. The pitch survives its two hardest hostile readings (ASR rebranding, certification-title overreach); three majors remain, all disclosure/scoping/interpretation level: the registered >=6-agent panel shrinking to 2 models is invisible in the text; the final field verdicts rest on author-side non-blind adjudication disclosed in artifacts but not in text; the 'charter spectrum' is a single-template result presented with single-template fragility unmeasured.

strengths.text: Failed attacks recorded as strengths: ASR-rebranding disproved by §3's explicit delta (charter mapping, censoring floor, isolation condition, Gamma, validation suite); certification-title overreach disproved by Table 5's production refusal-to-certify; instrument-churn story disclosed end-to-end (E2-v1b at §6.1 line 513, repaired-panel numbers only); leak semantics defended (disclosure-based); Wilson bounds recompute exactly everywhere checked; E17 FP bound [0,0.133] + rule-of-three printed; single-sentence thesis reconstructable; TOPS fit sound.

MAJOR: the decisive E29/E30/E31 audits (118 retractions, 112 validations) were author-side and non-blind per E29_E30_ORACLE_AUDIT.md; §5.6/§10 never carry the qualifier while the blind E17 calibration (n=25, FP bound 0.133) is foregrounded. Fix: disclose in §10(3), invite external re-adjudication of released transcripts, ideally add a blinded second adjudicator for the 230 flags.

Fix: run the frozen E22 paraphrase library on E31's panel or demote to 'gradient at the v0 template'.
